record.question: The burglar was taken to the _________ police station.
record.explanation: Answer A: nearest. Nearest means closest in distance, so nearest police station (A). Independent check: “Nearest police station” means the station closest to the point of arrest. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/near-nearer-nearest. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Exact printed question, choices and required directions/emphasis reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
